sources.entry: Lasso - Intuitive and easy to use grid-based window manager.

summary.name: Lasso
summary.one_liner: Lasso is a grid-based window manager for macOS that moves and resizes windows across multiple monitors by click-and-drag, saved layouts, and keyboard shortcuts.
use_cases: assigning keyboard shortcuts to window layouts
moving windows by dragging with modifier keys
switching from another macOS window manager
summary.what_it_does: Lasso lets users move and resize windows on macOS by clicking and dragging, or by holding modifier keys to act on the window under the cursor. Users can create and save their own window layouts and assign a unique keyboard shortcut to each one. It supports any number of monitors and can transfer windows between displays. Layouts can be shared or backed up, and settings can be synced across devices using iCloud. The page says common layouts and shortcuts from popular window managers are available to download to ease switching.
notable: Grid-based window organization with saved, shortcut-assignable layouts
Modifier-key move and resize of windows under the cursor
Settings sync across devices via iCloud
Preset layouts and shortcuts imported from popular window managers
caveats: 14-day window to change your mind on purchase, implying a paid product
Pricing details are not stated on the page
